scope: One isolated diagnostic clone of the existing holm oak; existing scene/species treatment unchanged

sources.cluster: Curved ellipsoidal field at each original group center/radii, selected by original spray groupId
sources.leaf: Original studioGeometry normal including existing per-card grid variation
sources.space: All three unit vectors transformed from tree-local to common world space; normalized weighted sum, deterministic crown fallback on cancellation

review.observation: Cards fragment the light; current hull loses clump volume; the requested blend restores local volume with less card breakup. Rounded cluster shading and subdued fine detail remain.
review.decision: Stop for human review; no weights tuned or scene promotion
